correctness.rationale: From the exact published secular coefficients, the Bloch condition is solved for \(Q\in[-2,2]\). Under \(k=N_n+x/N_n\), the exact quotient converges uniformly away from \(x=0\) to \((-1)^n(\sin(2\mu)\ell x/2-2\sin(2\mu)/(\ell x)-2\cos(2\mu))\) with \(O(N_n^{-2})\) error. The limiting function is strictly monotone on each half-line and has four simple roots at the claimed half-angle expressions. Implicit-function stability gives four exact edges with \(O(n^{-2})\) error. Finite bisection replay of the exact equation agrees and is explicitly treated only as corroboration.
